ValidationRule.description: Restricts the 'Date First Notified to SI' so it cannot be future dated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue' ), SI_First_Identified_Date__c > DATEVALUE(NOW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot select a future date
